results.title: Aztron Medtech Receives Presidential Award, Accelerates U.S. Commercial Expansion
results.description: NEWARK, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- #AchillesTendonRepair--Aztron Medtech receives Taiwan's Presidential Award and NT$10 million grand prize, accelerating U.S. expansion and orthopedic innovation.

results.title: Lusíadas Saúde will be the Official Medical Services Provider at Festival F in the Algarve
results.description: Lusíadas Saúde will, for the seventh consecutive year, serve as the Official Medical Services Provider for Festival F, taking place on 3, 4 and 5 September in Faro’s historic city centre.

results.title: Low-fat vegan diet may help people lose weight without eating less, say researchers
results.description: Washington DC: A low-fat vegan diet may support weight loss without the need to count calories, reduce portion sizes, or constantly battle hunger. In a 16-week clinical trial, participants following a diet centred on fruits, vegetables, grains and legumes consumed around 357 fewer calories per day, despite eating nearly the same amount of food overall.
